choices.source_procedure: After explicit physical-task approval, open the original SVG in a local editor; set paper A4 portrait and print at 100% actual size with fit-to-page disabled. Use one 120 gsm white sheet. Lay it flat, count 24 row pairs, measure center gap at top/middle/bottom with a millimeter ruler; require 12 mm within 0.5 mm. Log measured values and any merged/disappearing lines; if outside tolerance, stop and request a scale correction before further copies.
choices.use_proposal: For the next study, retain butt-capped endpoint construction and actual-size print control; compare at least two gap widths on the same sheet instead of assuming one width is perceptually sufficient. Record top/middle/bottom ruler measurements after authorization.

interpretation.statement: Explicit SVG endpoints and disabled fit-to-page should make a 12 mm gap reproducible; printing and visibility are not observed.
